sn35.230:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya ||
sn35.230:1.2: tam enam aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya ||
sn35.230:1.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa ||
sn35.230:2.1: evam eva kho bhikkhave cha yime baḷisā lokasmiṃ anayāya sattānaṃ vyābādhāya pāṇinaṃ || ||
sn35.230:2.3: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.230:2.4: tañ ce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.230:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu gilitabaliso Mārassa anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || pa || 7-8
sn35.230:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.230:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso Mārassa anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathakāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || || 10-12
sn35.230:4.1: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.230:4.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na gilitabaliso Mārassa || abhedi baḷisaṃ paribhedi baḷisam na anayam āpanno na vyasanam āpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || pa || || 13-14
sn35.230:5.2: Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā-rajanīyā ||
sn35.230:5.3: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivādati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na giḷitabaḷiso Mārassa || abhedi baḷisaṃ paribhedi baḷisaṃ na anayam āpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato
